checks: Requested functional behavior and invalid inputs work through the real entrypoint
Evidence honestly distinguishes exercised, unavailable and inferred results
Manual review remains read-only and findings survive falsification
Generated/untracked artifacts are directly inspected when created
review: Human review with artifact checks; no universal activation rate or model-judge certification
holdoutPolicy: Third case per skill is a holdout for future authorized trials; all grading requirements are disclosed. Fixtures alone are not independent general-efficacy evidence.
